pages.text: Upgrade II makes the radius 3x3 chunks. Use it in the Entropy Chamber and in the Materializer.
Upgrade III makes the radius 5x5 chunks.

The radius sets where a recipe takes its entropy from. A recipe starts when the sum of the chunks in the radius is enough, so a recipe can cost more than one chunk holds. The fullest chunk pays first.$(br2)The level (speed, bonus, overload) still comes from the chunk of the machine.
